content.text: /ext:medcp Choose a proton-pump inhibitor and tell me how many GERD patients received it.
I'll pick a common PPI (omeprazole) and count how many GERD patients received it. Let me first look at the available tables.

This is an OMOP CDM. I'll use omeprazole as the PPI. Let me find its concept and count distinct patients who have both a GERD condition and an omeprazole drug exposure (via concept_ancestor to capture all omeprazole ingredients/descendants).

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT DISTINCT de.person_id_count FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS person_id_count
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON de.drug_concept_id = ca.descendant_concept_id
  JOIN omop.concept ing ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = ing.concept_id
  WHERE ing.concept_class_id = 'Ingredient' AND LOWER(ing.concept_name) = 'omeprazole'
  AND de.person_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca2 ON co.condition_concept_id = ca2.descendant_concept_id
    JOIN omop.concept anc ON ca2.ancestor_concept_id = anc.concept_id
    WHERE LOWER(anc.concept_name) = 'gastroesophageal reflux disease'
  )
) de

content.text:
**Omeprazole** — a proton-pump inhibitor.

**43,478 GERD patients** received omeprazole (distinct patients with both a gastroesophageal reflux disease diagnosis and an omeprazole drug exposure, matched via OMOP concept-ancestor rollups).
